Sofia, I couldn't find that in the channels you can see, so I can't give you a name or title for the account sheet yet.

I checked #coastal-team, #coastal-random, #general and #help-it-ops, and your DM with me. None of them has a Coastal Sunday prep post from Moss naming a main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions. The Saltmarsh messages in #coastal-team are from October 2025, and they mention Corinne Ashdown as the person who flagged the dock problems. They don't say she is the main contact or give a title, so I wouldn't put her on the sheet from that alone.

The prep notes are probably in a channel or DM you're not in. I didn't search across everything, because that would pull in conversations you can't see. If you can tell me which channel the prep was posted in, I can check whether you have access to it. Otherwise, asking Moss directly or whoever ran the handoff would be the quickest route.
